From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:22:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (auth, SDK install, embedding/reranker)

Hi Joe — thanks for the payload and request IDs. We reproduced the 5xx locally using your payload and your batching pattern. Quick findings from initial triage:

1) Repro: Using Node SDK + 50ms batching we hit intermittent HTTP 502/500 when the reranker backend saw a burst of small concurrent requests. Repro command: curl against our test endpoint using finlytics-repro-payload.json produced same req_ ids.
2) Root causes observed: a) small-burst traffic pattern causing backend queue exhaustion on the reranker service, b) client-side socket timeout low for long tail token generation when the model hits ~1k tokens.
3) Temporary mitigation: increase client-side request timeout to 45s, add exponential backoff retries for 502/500 (max 3 attempts), and increase batching window to 100ms to reduce spike concurrency.

Attached is a small SDK patch that sets a higher default timeout and demonstrates batch coalescing. If you’re open, we can deploy a rate-limiting shim on our staging routing layer to smooth bursts for your account while we tune reranker autoscaling.

Can you confirm whether you can try the higher timeout + 100ms batching today and share the new req ids if you still hit 5xx? We’ll keep monitoring RED-4872 in parallel.

Thanks —
Camila
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Attachment: sdk-snippet.patch

From: Joe Perez <joe.perez@finlytics.com>

Camila — thanks for the quick triage. We applied the SDK patch and increased our client timeout to 45s and batching to 120ms. We ran the same job at 10:00 PDT and saw the following:

- New request IDs: req_20260831_100102, req_20260831_100204
- Result: no 5xx observed during a 30-minute run, tail latency reduced to ~450ms per token.

One strange thing: we saw one 429 spike (rate limit) around 10:07 with header x-rate-limit-reset: 18s. Not sure if that was us or an unrelated tenant causing a short throttle. Can you confirm whether the staging routing shim was enabled for our account?

If you can confirm routing and any sticky headers we should set to avoid cross-tenant throttling, we’ll run a longer batch overnight and report back.

—Joe
